question: Who gives the Bharat Muni Samman?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nalanda Dance Research Centre**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nalanda initiated a process **of honoring individuals who have acquired **iconic status **by **awarding **them with the **“Bharata Muni Samman”.**
 
• At their **renowned dance festival**, **Nalanda Nirityotsava**, which is **a four-day celebration **of **Indian classical dances**.
 
• Talking about the **Nalanda Nritya Nipuna **award for the youth**, Dr. Uma Rele **said, “This year we had **21 highly talented participants **in the **Nirtyotsava**, with a very **high standard of performances, **it was a difficult choice to make but after considering all the aspects of the dance presentation, the panel unanimously chose 12 dancers for the award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nalanda Nritya Kala Mahavidyalaya **was **established **in the **year 1973 **by the famous dancer academician **Padmabhushan Dr. (Smt.) Kanak Rele. Currently Dr. (Smt.) Uma Rele **is the **Principal of the college.**
 
• Awards given by** the President **are **Param Vir Chakra, Ashoka Chakra, Mahavir Chakra, Kiriti Chakra, Vir Chakra, and Saurya Chakra.**
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi **is the **national-level **academy for **performing arts set up by the Government of India**.
 
• **The Government of India **instituted **two civilian awards**-**Bharat Ratna & Padma Vibhushan **in 1954 and **Padma Vibhushan**, **Padma Bhushan **and **Padma Shri **vide Presidential Notification issued on **January 8, 1955**.
